text:
client-jordan: Hi team — hit a user report: their chat session got a half-response then the SSE closed. Client shows HTTP/1.1 200 then socket close after ~18s.
client-jordan: Happened over mobile (carrier X) while switching from 4G->5G. Request_id: r_0a9f3c. Billing charged for partial tokens — customer upset. Any quick triage?
support-alex: Sorry about that — can you paste the raw client logs and the server request_id header? also which SDK?
client-jordan: Using our Android app, okhttp SSE wrapper. Raw log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-12T15:21:04Z] connect -> 200
[2026-03-12T15:21:06Z] receive: {"delta":"partial text..."}
[2026-03-12T15:21:22Z] socket closed (EOF)
```
client-jordan: Req headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, X-Req-Id: r_0a9f3c, Accept: text/event-stream
support-alex: thx. Can you try repro with a stable wifi (to rule out carrier proxy kill) and also capture tcpdump/pcap if possible? Also we'll look at server side traces.
incidents-bot: New support ticket created: #SUP-3821 (priority: p2) by support-alex
sre-maria: @support-alex grabbing the trace now for r_0a9f3c — seeing server sent 2 events then connection FIN from client side. No server error logged. TTL for token looked fine.
sre-maria: I also see a bunch of RSTs from IP that map to carrier-proxy (AS45123) around the same second — could be carrier NAT mapping expired mid-stream when the client changed cell sectors.
eng-ryan: Thanks. Two quick mitigations: (1) suggest client set a lightweight keepalive heartbeat (send comment events or small nop) every 10s, (2) use the SSE resume-id pattern we rolled out last quarter — if client reconnects it can pass resume-id to get missing tokens.
support-alex: client-jordan can you re-run reproducer with this curl to simulate: 
```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-x" | sed -n '1,50p'
```
support-alex: If it truncates on carrier wifi but not on stable wifi, likely carrier NAT/proxy.
client-jordan: repro on wifi is clean. On mobile it drops consistently when toggling airplane mode quickly. Will try keepalive patch next.
sre-maria: Also toggled a small server-side config to extend idle keepalive to 45s for SSE connections in edge region eu-west-1 for retries. This should reduce immediate kills from short NAT flaps.
product-olivia: Noting customer billing concern — if session ended mid-stream we should consider pro-rating or crediting tokens for SUP-3821 while we investigate.
support-alex: Agreed — I'll flag billing and offer a temporary credit pending repro confirmation.
eng-ryan: For the SDK we recommend adding Connection: keep-alive + periodic comment events: 
```
// pseudo
sse.sendComment(':ping') // every 10s
```
eng-ryan: We'll add a quick FAQ snippet in devex about mobile carrier NATs and resume-id usage.
client-jordan: Patch applied, keepalive reduces reproducer rate from 80% -> ~5%. Thanks. We'll validate with customer.
support-alex: Great — I'll mark SUP-3821 as under investigation but with mitigation in place. If you can upload a pcap we can confirm with carrier mapping.
client-jordan: Will follow up with pcap and final confirmation. Thanks all :thumbsup:
